# Title
Harch Atelier — Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for the francophone world

# Description
Harch Atelier makes your business appear in AI-generated answers across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and GLM. We serve francophone markets: France, Morocco, Belgium, Switzerland, Quebec, Tunisia, Lebanon, Senegal.

# Service
- Audit: 200+ queries tested against 4 AI engines. Board-ready PDF report. Free, 1 week.
- Optimize: Content restructure, entity signals, Schema.org JSON-LD, E-E-A-T content, AEO files. 30K-80K MAD, 2-4 weeks.
- Monitor: Monthly citation tracking across 4 LLMs. 5K-15K MAD/month, cancel anytime.

# Pricing
- Audit: 0 MAD (free, no commitment)
- Optimize: 30,000-80,000 MAD one-time
- Monitor: 5,000-15,000 MAD/month
- Payment: bank transfer (Moroccan RIB, French IBAN, international wire). No Stripe.

# Process
1. Research: 200+ queries × 4 AI engines → gap analysis, entity audit, citation inventory
2. Optimize: semantic structure, Schema.org, E-E-A-T content, AEO files, GitHub delivery
3. Monitor: monthly retest, citation tracking, competitor analysis, content updates
4. Measure: citations/200, share of voice, average position — tracked monthly

# AI Engines Covered
ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, GLM, Grok

# Francophone Markets
France, Morocco, Belgium, Switzerland, Quebec, Tunisia, Lebanon, Senegal
